units: <cite ref="Niddah 17a:78">Nidd. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ אינו לא אוכל וכ׳</he> snow belongs neither to the class of solid food nor of liquids (for Levitical law).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:3">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ</cite> bot. two paths <he>אחד … של ש׳</he> one of fire and the other of snow; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 28:10">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXVIII</cite>. Tanḥ. R’eh 13, a. e., v. <cite ref="R00531"><he>צַלְמָוֶת</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁלָגִים</he>, <he>שְׁלָגִין</he>. Nidd. l. c.
